description: This file defines the FullTextFilter class implementing ILiquidFilter for processing content items and extracting full-text segments for indexing within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: FullTextFilter
classes.description: A class implementing ILiquidFilter to process content items and extract full-text segments for search indexing.

methods.name: ProcessAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes input content items to extract and return full-text segments for indexing.

methods.name: GetContentItem
methods.description: Converts a FluidValue into a ContentItem object if possible, handling JSON objects and null cases.
